automatic_selection_contract.selection_rule: Choose one smallest sufficient primary lens. Add a supporting lens only when one material decision crosses owners. A routine or already-specified task selects no advisory. Mandatory security, authority, privacy, destructive-effect, recovery, and claim guards remain active regardless of preference.
automatic_selection_contract.selection_identity: SHA-256 over the exact canonical input fields and ordered selected lens identities
automatic_selection_contract.authority_boundary: The projection can recommend only. It cannot issue a lease, permission, effect, retry, acceptance, readiness, release, completion, or claim decision.
automatic_selection_contract.fail_closed: Missing, extra, stale, duplicate, substituted, disabled, or cross-candidate skills and profiles return a visible non-effect disposition.

reactivate_when: active truth-loop or first broken transition changes
protected invariant or contemplated effect changes
material assumption or missing input changes
risk, oracle, evidence class, or failure class changes
replay, fencing, recovery, or terminal-state ambiguity changes
plugin, profile, selector, or selected skill identity changes
reactivation_contract.do_not_reactivate_when: Candidate, context, lifecycle, evidence, hypothesis, mechanism, and trigger facts are byte-identical to the prior selection.
reactivation_contract.stale_advice_behavior: Reject the advice and derive a new selection from current UltraGoal authority.
reactivation_contract.loop_breaker: A repeated selection with no new evidence, hypothesis, mechanism, or lifecycle condition returns no_advisory_needed with advice_current rather than invoking another advisory pass.

adoption_contract.rule: Only an existing UltraGoal root, plan, work-package, schema, migration, verification, Product Fitness, or improvement owner can adopt an advisory proposal. No adoption row is a lease, effect, review acceptance, or claim promotion.

progressive_disclosure.explicit_request_rule: An advanced user may request a skill, discipline, pathway, or review lens. The request is an input to selection and cannot disable protected guards, widen effects, or raise claims.

profile_contract.coverage: The union of core, lifecycle, and rust contains all 30 Agentic Engineering skills.
profile_contract.adaptation: UltraGoal derives co-install projections from these exact source profiles, disables the Agentic implicit gateway, binds the external Harness gateway, plugin version, plugin digest, candidate, configuration, and profile digest, and refuses missing or extra skills.

full_profile.release_condition: Retain only after exact combined Harness-plus-Agentic discovery measurement shows durable headroom and no routing degradation.

measured_upstream_only.claim_boundary: Upstream Agentic-only structural estimate; not a combined installed UltraGoal profile or fresh-session discovery observation.

skill_policy.applies_to: Every skill_decisions row. Row-specific purpose, lifecycle, owner, trigger, non-trigger, adaptation, verification, and ceiling combine with these shared authority, invalidation, compatibility, and retention fields to form one complete per-skill disposition.
skill_policy.candidate_invalidation: candidate, context, lifecycle, trigger, plugin, profile, skill, or directly consumed resource identity changes
skill_policy.compatibility_and_migration: No peer schema or state migration. Existing P0/P1 owners remain authoritative; stage-scoped profile and selection behavior are additive and fail closed.
skill_policy.retention_and_retirement: Retain while a representative trigger remains useful and the selected lens preserves protected boundaries. Narrow or retire through the existing improvement and migration authorities when behavior evaluation shows no value or harmful overlap.
